test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

DF, LH, RL, ?
solution:
**Explanation:-**

According to the English alphabet and its positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• **First alphabets is increased to -2 positional value of the previous difference.**
 
• Second alphabets is increased to +2 positional value of the previous difference.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b7ad40140886f5a1d631e3ca69bbfe2d6040a62e093ebfe11d2ea5aa49e4577.png] 

**Hence the correct answer is option 2.**
